tools.name: scan_contract_selectors
tools.description: Stage 1 Free deterministic inspection of smart contract bytecode on Base or EVM chains. Discovers 4-byte function selectors and flags high-risk administrative capabilities (ownership transfer, proxy upgrade, unconstrained minting, selfdestruct).

tools.name: check_token_honeypot
tools.description: Stage 1 Free static bytecode scanner for honeypot indicators on DEX tokens: blacklist manipulation (isBlacklisted, setBlacklist), arbitrary transfer taxes / 100% sell fee traps, trading freeze backdoors, and selfdestruct opcodes.

tools.name: scan_dao_proposals
tools.description: Stage 1 Free scanner for recent Snapshot DAO governance proposals (Arbitrum, Aave, ENS). Extracts on-chain target addresses and calldata execution payloads to detect governance takeover attempts and discrepancies.

tools.name: deep_semantic_audit
tools.description: Stage 2 Deep Semantic LLM Security and Governance Audit. Performs deterministic on-chain gatekeeping followed by structured Gemini LLM evaluation over natural language proposal claims vs bytecode and calldata reality. Requires $0.05 USDC x402 micropayment on Base Mainnet.
